facts.fact: OnTech.tn reports Orange Tunisie unveiled its new 1,000 m2 data centre at Kalaa Kebira, Sousse, offering colocation, dedicated hosting and private or hybrid cloud to clients; the document gives no event date, so its published date 2025-05-05 is used.

OnTech.tn reports the Orange Tunisie Kalaa Kebira, Sousse data centre was designed and built to the Tier III standard with N+1 redundancy, and quotes Orange executives citing Tier III certification, without naming a certifier; the document gives no event date, so its published date 2025-05-05 is used.

note: carried from datacentres; no document opened
